Title: Schema Registry for Azure Event Hubs public preview

Body.Content:
The Azure Schema Registry has been released as a feature of Event Hubs providing a central repository for schema documents for event-driven and messaging-centric applications. The Schema Registry also provides a simple governance framework for reusable schemas and defines the relationship between schemas through schema groups.

Please read the Messaging on Azure Tech Community blog for more information.
